A '''Sector Monitor''' was a collection of agencies that were part of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's]] [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Coalition for Progress]]. They collected and sorted data on cultural progress within a [[Sector/Legends|sector]], divided into five separate branches; [[Art (COMPNOR)/Legends|Art]], [[Science/Legends|Science]], [[Commerce (department)/Legends|Commerce]], [[Education/Legends|Education]], and [[Justice (department)/Legends|Justice]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
